relations.statement: For twice-spins at most 6 and admissible triads, sixj_sq equals Racah's single-sum rational (triangle coefficients squared times squared alternating sum) with exact integer factorials; sixj is sign times sqrt of it
relations.hypotheses: all six twice-spins <= 6; four triads admissible (parity and triangle); otherwise value is 0

relations.statement: Biedenharn-Elliott identity for classical 6j symbols over all admissible labels in range
relations.hypotheses: all labels twice-spin <= 6, all involved triads admissible

lemmas.statement: sixj_sq a b c d e f is rational and equals the Racah single-sum expression, decidable by enumeration for twice-spins <= 6
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem racah_sq (a b c d e f : Fin 7) : sixjSq a b c d e f = racahSum a b c d e f := by sorry

lemmas.statement: sixj is invariant under the 24 tetrahedral symmetries (column permutations and swapping upper/lower in two columns)
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem sixj_sym (a b c d e f : Fin 7) : sixjSq a b c d e f = sixjSq b a c e d f := by sorry

lemmas.statement: Sum over x of (2x+1)(2y+1){a b x;c d y}{a b x;c d y'} = delta(y,y') for admissible y,y'

near_misses.claim: The level-2 q-deformed 6j of TFQ-0105 or the Cyclo12 vertexAmplitude equals the classical 6j
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Classical 6j is real, rational-squared, with no root-of-unity truncation; the q-deformed one is in Z[zeta_12] with labels 0..2 only

near_misses.claim: sixj equals the positive square root of sixj_sq
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The sign is determined by the Racah sum and can be negative, e.g. alternating sum sign
